# Build farm for SUPERCUT

Lane farm1, 14 Nov 2026. Other PCs build, test, package and run SUPERCUT for lanes on c4. Git, agents and the
source of truth stay on c4. A farm PC holds a plain copy of a project folder (a "mirror"), never a git repo.
Nothing is ever pushed with git.

## Changes of 15 Nov 13:25 (main thread). These win over the older text below.

- **c4 is a farm host** (`farm.sh ... c4 ...`, root `D:\UE`, no ssh). `mirror c4 <name> <worktree>` copies nothing:
  it makes `D:\UE\Farm\<name>` a junction to the worktree, so steps build inside the worktree. Packages land in
  `D:\UE\Farm\_builds\<name>`, logs in `D:\UE\Farm\_out\<name>\<step>`. The owner freed c4 for this jam on 15 Nov
  ("C4 is free for lanes to use... speed is the priority"). No real input, no sound, and nothing in
  `D:\UE\Builds` or `D:\UE\Projects\Supercut59` is touched.
- **`farm.sh` queues by itself.** `build`, `test`, `package`, `package-shipping` and `run` take a slot in
  `D:\UE\Farm\_locks\<host>.<i>` (file `owner`: pid, name, step, start) and wait inside the call when none is free.
  Slots: [pc-c] 3, c4 2, [pc-b] 2, pc2 1. A `run` takes slot 1 only, so one game per PC at a time holds without
  anyone checking. A slot whose `farm.sh` is gone, or older than an hour, is freed by the next caller.
  `farm.sh slots` lists the holders. The load check in "Before a heavy step" is no longer needed for lanes; the
  rule about a tester's own `Supercut` process still is.

# Lane `figure`: the three enemies as wooden lay figures

13 Nov 2026. Blender 5.0.1 only. Unreal was never started, no game source was changed, no git command was run.
Everything marked "measured" came out of a script in `src\`. Everything marked "believed" was read or reasoned
and not run.

## What was built

Three skinned meshes on the UAL1 skeleton (Quaternius Universal Animation Library, CC0, 65 bones), plus 13 of the
pack's 43 clips, exported as FBX. Each figure is a set of separate turned-wood pieces: egg head with no face, neck
peg and neck ball, chest barrel, waist ball, pelvis block, tapered upper and lower limbs, balls at shoulder, elbow,
wrist, hip, knee and ankle, a mitten hand with a thumb, and a wedge foot cut at the toe joint.

Every piece is weighted 1.0 to exactly one bone, so nothing bends or shears. 19 bones carry a piece: `Head`,
`neck_01`, `spine_03` (chest), `spine_02` (waist ball), `pelvis`, and per side `upperarm`, `lowerarm`, `hand`,
`thigh`, `calf`, `foot`, `ball` (the toe). The other 46 bones (fingers, clavicles, `spine_01`, `root`) stay in the
skeleton and carry nothing, so every pack clip still plays.

Each build: 4,812 triangles, 2,482 vertices, one UV channel, two material slots: `M_LayFigure_Wood` (slot 0) and
`M_LayFigure_Joint` (slot 1, the darker balls).

Why it is built this way: the first box-built enemies were rejected. A lay figure is rigid pieces on joints, so
rigid skinning is the correct model of the object, and it is also what keeps a wooden figure from looking like a
person in a wood-print bodysuit (see picture 4).

# Exports the three lay figures and the chosen clips as FBX for Unreal 5.9.
#   "D:/Blender/blender.exe" -b --factory-startup -P export_fbx.py
# Reads figures.blend (metres) and writes:
#   ../fbx/SK_LayFigure_<Build>.fbx        skeletal mesh + the shared 65-bone skeleton, rest pose, no animation
#   ../fbx/anim/A_LayFigure_<Clip>.fbx     skeleton only, one clip, 30 fps, every frame keyed
#
# Why these settings (the round trip is checked by verify_fbx.py):
# - The copy that is exported is turned into real centimetres first (bones, mesh and location keys x100, scene
#   unit 0.01). The file then says "1 unit = 1 cm" and no node carries a scale, so no importer has to undo one.
# - Axes -Z forward, Y up: Blender's default and the layout Unreal's importers convert from. The figure faces
#   -Y in Blender and +Y in Unreal, like the engine's own mannequin.
# - The armature object stays named "Armature" and has the root bone as its only child. Unreal's importers
#   (FbxMainImport.cpp, Interchange FbxAPI.cpp and UfbxParser.cpp) drop a Blender null of that name, so the
#   skeleton's root is the bone "root". The mesh is not parented to the armature in the file, because the
#   ufbx parser keeps the null when it has more than one child.
# - No leaf bones are added, bone axes are left as they are (primary Y, secondary X), nothing is simplified.
# - A clip file has no mesh, so it has no bind pose, and Blender writes each bone node's own transform from the
#   pose at the scene's current frame. Left alone, every clip file would carry a different "rest pose" (measured:
#   up to 120 cm away from the T-pose). So each clip gets one extra key holding the rest pose one frame before
#   its first frame, and the scene is parked on that frame during the export. The baked range is unchanged.

 * (ShowClip), builds it in BuildBody and fights in TickCombat. Shots only ever meet the capsule.
 * Shots, upgrades, the run and the scripted player only ever see this class.
 *
 * A hit plays Hit_Chest, then the kind's own clip again. A killed enemy plays Death01 and lies where it
 * fell, holding the last frame, until the room goes. From the kill on, nothing of it collides.
 *
 * A hit while rolling also holds this enemy's own clock (USupercutTime::Hold, HitHoldSeconds, or
 * KillHoldSeconds on a kill, when Death01 waits for the hold to end) and shakes the drawn figure, never the
 * capsule or the actor (HitShakeCm). In a freeze neither happens.
 *
 * Everything runs on the actor's own tick time. The base joins the frozen scene, so a freeze gives
 * every kind a tick of zero seconds and the base returns before any kind code runs: mid-windup,

}

	const FVector There = TargetActor->GetActorLocation();

		if (!CanSee(TargetActor, Tuning.RusherSightRange, RusherEyeHeight))

			break;   // it waits where it is until it sees the player
		}
		TurnTowards(There, Tuning.RusherTurnRate, DeltaSeconds);
		if (FVector::Dist2D(Here, There) <= Tuning.RusherLungeRange)
		{
			Enter(ERusherState::Windup);
			UE_LOG(LogSupercut, Display, TEXT("RUSHER %d winds up, %.0f cm from the player"), GetIndex(), FVector::Dist2D(Here, There));
			break;
		}
		{
			bRanThisTick = true;
			FVector ToTarget = There - Here;
			ToTarget.Z = 0.f;
			FVector Next = Here + ToTarget.GetSafeNormal() * (Tuning.RusherRunSpeed * DeltaSeconds);
			const FVector2D Clamped = ClampToHome(Next);
			Next.X = Clamped.X;
			Next.Y = Clamped.Y;
			FHitResult Hit;
			SetActorLocation(Next, true, &Hit);
			if (Hit.bBlockingHit)
			{
				// Slide along what it ran into, so a crate corner does not stop it dead.
				FVector Slide = FVector::VectorPlaneProject(Next - GetActorLocation(), Hit.Normal);
				Slide.Z = 0.f;
				FVector SlideTo = GetActorLocation() + Slide;
				const FVector2D SlideClamped = ClampToHome(SlideTo);
				SlideTo.X = SlideClamped.X;
				SlideTo.Y = SlideClamped.Y;
				SetActorLocation(SlideTo, true);
			}
		}
		break;

	case ERusherState::Windup:
		TurnTowards(There, Tuning.RusherTurnRate, DeltaSeconds);
		if (StateClock >= Tuning.RusherWindup)
		{
			// The direction is fixed now. Where the player goes from here does not change it.
			FVector ToTarget = There - Here;

		}
		break;

	case ERusherState::Lunge:
		TickLunge(DeltaSeconds, TargetActor);
		break;

	case ERusherState::Recover:
		if (StateClock >= RestFor)
		{
			Enter(ERusherState::Run);
		}
		break;
	}
	UpdatePose();
	UpdateClip(TargetActor);
}

#pragma once

#include "CoreMinimal.h"

/** What an enemy is doing with its body, apart from where it is going. */
enum class ESupercutEnemyAct : uint8
{
	None,      // nothing special: standing or moving
	Aim,       // weapon up, about to fire
	Fire,      // a shot has just left
	Reload,
	Throw,     // lobbing a grenade
	Strike,    // a melee hit
	Hit,       // flinching from damage
	Dead,
};

/**
 * An enemy's body state for this frame. The enemy's own code (what it does) writes it every tick it runs;
 * the figure's clip picker (what it looks like) reads it. Neither side reaches into the other.
 */
struct FSupercutEnemyMotion
{
	FVector Velocity = FVector::ZeroVector;   // world space, cm/s, in scene time; zero when it stands
	bool bCrouched = false;
	bool bInAir = false;                      // jumping or falling
	float AirSeconds = 0.f;                   // scene time since it left the ground; 0 on the ground
	ESupercutEnemyAct Act = ESupercutEnemyAct::None;
	float ActSeconds = 0.f;                   // scene time since Act last changed
};

#!/bin/bash
# farm.sh: build, test, package and run a SUPERCUT project copy on a farm PC, driven from c4. Details: ../FARM.md.
#
#   farm.sh mirror  <host> <name> <project folder on c4>     copy the project to <root>\Farm\<name> (changed files only)
#   farm.sh build   <host> <name> <log folder> [build.ps1 args, e.g. -Target Supercut -Jobs 8]
#   farm.sh test    <host> <name> <log folder> [run_tests.ps1 args, e.g. -Filter Supercut.Rooms]
#   farm.sh package <host> <name> <log folder>               Tools\package.cmd   -> <root>\Farm\_builds\<name>\Supercut59
#   farm.sh package-shipping <host> <name> <log folder>      Tools\package_shipping.cmd -> ...\_builds\<name>\Supercut59_ship
#   farm.sh run     <host> <name> <log folder> [run_demo.ps1 args]   {P} = the mirror folder there, e.g. -Script {P}\Script\main8.txt
#   farm.sh fetch   <host> <name> <remote path> <local folder>   path in the mirror, or builds/... or out/...
#   farm.sh status  <host>
#   farm.sh slots                                             who holds or waits for which PC right now
#
# Each step brings its logs back to <log folder>/<step>/ and exits with the remote step's exit code.
# Logs that come back have the PC's user and computer names replaced by USER and PC.
#
# Hosts: [pc-b], pc2, [pc-c], pc4 over ssh, and c4 itself (15 Nov: the owner freed c4 for lanes). On c4 nothing is
# copied: "mirror" makes D:\UE\Farm\<name> a junction to the project folder, so the steps build in that folder.
#
# Slots (15 Nov): build, test, package, package-shipping and run take one of the host's slots and wait for one
# when all are taken, so the lanes no longer pile onto one PC. A slot whose farm.sh has died is taken over.
set -u
here=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)
root_of() {   # one line per farm PC: ssh alias, root folder there (engine in <root>\UE_5.9, mirrors in <root>\Farm)
  case "$1" in
    [pc-b]) echo 'C:\UE' ;;
    pc2)    echo 'C:\UE' ;;
    [pc-c])   echo 'F:\UE' ;;
    pc4)    echo 'C:\UE' ;;
    c4)     echo 'D:\UE' ;;
    *) echo "FARM unknown host '$1' ([pc-b], pc2, [pc-c], pc4, c4)" >&2; exit 64 ;;
  esac
}
slots_of() {  # heavy steps at once on each PC
  case "$1" in
    [pc-b]) echo 2 ;;
    pc2)    echo 1 ;;
    [pc-c])   echo 3 ;;
    c4)     echo 2 ;;
    *)      echo 1 ;;
  esac
}
fwd() { echo "${1//\\//}"; }   # C:\UE -> C:/UE for scp and tar

lockdir=/d/UE/Farm/_locks

ubt=''

cd /d/UE/wt/enemyanim1 && python - <<'EOF'
p="Tools/retarget_mixamo.py"
s=open(p,encoding="utf-8").read()
old='''def stats(tgt, meshes, frames):'''
new='''def stride_speed(tgt, frames, fps):
    """Ground speed a loop walks at, cm/s at rate 1 and scale 1: a toe within 1 cm of its lowest point on two
    frames running is planted, and its speed over the floor then is the ground speed. The median of those."""
    scene = bpy.context.scene
    toes = {s: [] for s in ("ball_l", "ball_r")}
    for f in frames:
        scene.frame_set(f)
        for s in toes:
            toes[s].append(bone_world(tgt, s, True)[0] * 100)
    speeds = []
    for pts in toes.values():
        low = min(p.z for p in pts)
        for a, b in zip(pts, pts[1:]):
            if a.z < low + 1.0 and b.z < low + 1.0:
                speeds.append(((b - a).to_2d()).length * fps)
    speeds.sort()
    return speeds[len(speeds) // 2] if speeds else 0.0


def stats(tgt, meshes, frames):'''
s=s.replace(old,new)
old='''    speed = drift.length * 100 * fps'''
new='''    speed = drift.length * 100 * fps
    if locomotion:
        print("RETARGET %s: stride speed %.1f cm/s at rate 1 and scale 1" % (name, stride_speed(tgt, frames, fps)))'''
s=s.replace(old,new)
open(p,"w",encoding="utf-8",newline="\n").write(s)
EOF

	if (Choice.Clip == ESupercutClip::None)
	{
		UE_LOG(LogSupercut, Fatal, TEXT("%s %d reached the pose %s and has no clip for it (its GetClipSet)."), GetKindName(), Index, SupercutFigure::PoseName(Pose));
	}
	ShownPose = Pose;
	if (bRestart || Choice.Clip != Shown)
	{
		StartClip(Choice.Clip);
	}
	Figure->SetPlayRate(SupercutFigure::PoseRate(Choice, Pose, Motion, Figure->GetRelativeScale3D().X));
}

class USkeletalMeshComponent;
class UStaticMeshComponent;
class UMaterialInstanceDynamic;

/**
 * What every enemy kind shares: health, taking a hit and its flash, dying, the one it fights, the
 * floor area it may move in, its number in the room, and stopping in a freeze.
 *
 * A kind (Grunt, Rusher, Marksman) is a wooden lay figure (AddFigure) that plays one clip at a time, builds it
 * in BuildBody and fights in TickCombat. Shots only ever meet the capsule. The clip is picked from Motion alone
 * (SupercutFigure::PickPose) out of the kind's table (GetClipSet), after every combat frame.
 * Shots, upgrades, the run and the scripted player only ever see this class.
 *
 * A hit plays the kind's hit clip, then the kind's own clip again. A killed enemy plays its death clip and lies
 * where it fell, holding the last frame, until the room goes. From the kill on, nothing of it collides.
 *
 * A hit while rolling also holds this enemy's own clock (USupercutTime::Hold, HitHoldSeconds, or
 * KillHoldSeconds on a kill, when Death01 waits for the hold to end) and shakes the drawn figure, never the
 * capsule or the actor (HitShakeCm). In a freeze neither happens.
 *
 * Everything runs on the actor's own tick time. The base joins the frozen scene, so a freeze gives
 * every kind a tick of zero seconds and the base returns before any kind code runs: mid-windup,
 * mid-lunge and mid-aim all stop where they are, and no timer counts. Its clip stops with it: the figure
 * ticks with the actor's time dilation.
 */
UCLASS(Abstract)
class ASupercutEnemy : public AActor
{
	GENERATED_BODY()

public:
	ASupercutEnemy();

	virtual void BeginPlay() override;
	virtual void Tick(float DeltaSeconds) override;

	void TakeHit(int32 Damage, const FVector& ShotDirection);

	int32 GetHealth() const { return Health; }
	bool IsDying() const { return bDying; }
	/** Enemies are numbered 0, 1, 2 in the order of their lines in the room file, whatever their kind. */
	int32 GetIndex() const { return Index; }
	FBox2D GetHome() const { return Home; }
	FVector GetChestLocation() const { return GetActorLocation() + FVector(0.f, 0.f, ChestHeight); }

	/** What its body is doing this frame (SupercutEnemyMotion.h). */
	const FSupercutEnemyMotion& GetMotion

	const float EnemyGunTestStep = 0.01f;   // seconds per tick
	const FVector EnemyGunMeshMuzzle(13.5905f, 0.0261f, 1.1714f);   // Art/held/Revolver.json "muzzle", in SM_Revolver_Body's space

	struct FEnemyGunTestWorld : FTestWorldWrapper
	{
		bool Start()
		{
			if (!CreateTestWorld(EWorldType::Game))
			{
				return false;
			}
			GetTestWorld()->GetWorldSettings()->DefaultGameMode = AGameModeBase::StaticClass();
			return BeginPlayInTestWorld();
		}

		void Run(float Seconds)
		{
			const int32 Ticks = FMath::RoundToInt(Seconds / EnemyGunTestStep);
			for (int32 Tick = 0; Tick < Ticks; ++Tick)
			{
				TickTestWorld(EnemyGunTestStep);
			}
		}

		template <typename T>
		T* Spawn(const FVector& Location, const FRotator& Rotation = FRotator::ZeroRotator)
		{
			FActorSpawnParameters Params;
			Params.SpawnCollisionHandlingOverride = ESpawnActorCollisionHandlingMethod::AlwaysSpawn;
			return GetTestWorld()->SpawnActor<T>(Location, Rotation, Params);
		}
	};

	const TCHAR* const EnemyGunMeshes[] = { TEXT("SM_Revolver_Body"), TEXT("SM_Revolver_Crane"), TEXT("SM_Revolver_Cylinder"), TEXT("SM_Revolver_Ejector"),
		TEXT("SM_Revolver_Hammer"), TEXT("SM_Revolver_Trigger") };

	/** The enemy's static mesh parts by mesh name. */
	TMap<FString, UStaticMeshComponent*> EnemyGunParts(AActor* Enemy)
	{
		TMap<FString, UStaticMeshComponent*> Parts;
		Enemy->ForEachComponent<UStaticMeshComponent>(false, [&Parts](UStaticMeshComponent* Part)
		{
			if (Part->GetStaticMesh())
			{
				Parts.Add(Part->GetStaticMesh()->GetName(), Part);
			}
		});
		return Parts;
	}
}

void ASupercutGrunt::Setup(int32 InIndex, const FBox2D& InHome)
{
	SetPlace(InIndex, InHome);
	// Stagger the first shots and the first sidestep so three Grunts do not act as one.
	FireClock = -0.45f * InIndex;
	StrafeClock = 0.7f * InIndex;
	StrafeSign = (InIndex % 2 == 0) ? 1.f : -1.f;
}

Each old text must\n# occur exactly once.\nimport sys\n\npath, edits_path = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]\ntext = open(path, \"rb\").read().decode(\"utf-8\")\ncrlf = \"\\r\\n\" in text\ntext = text.replace(\"\\r\\n\", \"\\n\")\nspec = open(edits_path, \"rb\").read().decode(\"utf-8\").replace(\"\\r\\n\", \"\\n\")\nblocks = spec.split(\"<<<<\\n\")[1:]\nfor block in blocks:\n    old, rest = block.split(\"\\n====\\n\", 1)\n    new = rest.rsplit(\"\\n>>>>\", 1)[0]\n    count = text.count(old)\n    if count != 1:\n        sys.exit(\"FAIL: old text found %d times:\\n%s\" % (count, old[:300]))\n    text = text.replace(old, new)\nif crlf or path.endswith((\".cpp\", \".h\", \".py\")):\n    text = text.replace(\"\\n\", \"\\r\\n\")\nopen(path, \"wb\").write(text.encode(\"utf-8\"))\nprint(\"OK\", path, len(blocks), \"edits\")\n"
}

void ASupercutMarksman::BuildBody()
{
	AddFigure(TEXT("Marksman"), MarksmanFigureScale);
	USceneComponent* Gun = SupercutEnemyGun::Add(this, GetFigure());
	LineMaterial = SupercutShapes::Glow(this, SupercutShapes::SignalColor(SupercutShapes::ESignal::Danger), FSupercutTuning::Get().MarksmanLineGlow);
	// On the drawn muzzle: the line starts here. Its size is in world cm whatever the figure's scale.

	Line = SupercutShapes::Add(this, RootComponent, ESupercutShape::Cylinder, FVector::ZeroVector, FRotator::ZeroRotator, FVector(1.f), LineMaterial);

	Line->SetVisibility(false, true);
}

    print("F", f, " | ".join(out))

	case ESupercutClip::RifleIdle:      return TEXT("Rifle_Idle");
	case ESupercutClip::RifleAim:       return TEXT("Rifle_Aim_Idle");
	case ESupercutClip::RifleFire:      return TEXT("Rifle_Fire");
	case ESupercutClip::None:
	case ESupercutClip::Count:
		break;
	}
	checkNoEntry();
	return TEXT("");
}

bool SupercutFigure::IsLoop(ESupercutClip Clip)
{
	switch (Clip)
	{
	case ESupercutClip::Idle:
	case ESupercutClip::Sprint:
	case ESupercutClip::PistolIdle:
	case ESupercutClip::PistolAim:
	case ESupercutClip::PistolRunFwd:

	case ESupercutClip::CrouchFwd:
	case ESupercutClip::JumpLoop:
	case ESupercutClip::RifleIdle:
	case ESupercutClip::RifleAim:
		return true;
	default:
		return false;
	}
}

void ASupercutEnemy::StartClip(ESupercutClip Clip)
{
	Shown = Clip;
	Figure->PlayAnimation(SupercutFigure::Clip(Clip), SupercutFigure::IsLoop(Clip));
	Figure->SetPosition(0.f, false);
	Figure->SetPlayRate(1.f);
}

void ASupercutEnemy::UpdateLook(bool bRestart)
{
	const ESupercutPose Pose = SupercutFigure::PickPose(Motion, GetActorForwardVector(), ShownPose, Figure->IsPlaying());
	const FSupercutClipChoice& Choice = GetClipSet()[Pose];
	if (Choice.Clip == ESupercutClip::None)
	{
		UE_LOG(LogSupercut, Fatal, TEXT("%s %d reached the pose %s and has no clip for it (its GetClipSet)."), GetKindName(), Index, SupercutFigure::PoseName(Pose));
	}
	ShownPose = Pose;
	if (bRestart || Choice.Clip != Shown)
	{
		StartClip(Choice.Clip);
	}
	Figure->SetPlayRate(SupercutFigure::PoseRate(Choice, Pose, Motion, Figure->GetRelativeScale3D().X));
}

void ASupercutGrunt::TickCombat(float DeltaSeconds, AActor* TargetActor)
{
	const FSupercutTuning& Tuning = FSupercutTuning::Get();
	bFiredThisTick = false;
	const FVector Here = GetActorLocation();
	const FVector There = TargetActor->GetActorLocation();
	FVector Flat = There - Here;
	Flat.Z = 0.f;
	const float Distance = Flat.Size();
	const FVector ToTarget = Flat.GetSafeNormal();

	// Can it see the player? A line from its head to the player's middle, stopped by walls and cover.
	const bool bSees = CanSee(TargetActor, Tuning.GruntSightRange, GruntEyeHeight);

	if (bSees)
	{
		TurnTowards(There, Tuning.GruntTurnRate, DeltaSeconds);

		// Keep the distance, and step sideways.
		StrafeClock += DeltaSeconds;
		if (StrafeClock >= Tuning.GruntStrafeSeconds)
		{
			StrafeClock = 0.f;
			StrafeSign = -StrafeSign;
		}
		float Radial = 0.f;
		if (Distance < Tuning.GruntMinRange)
		{
			Radial = -1.f;
		}
		else if (Distance > Tuning.GruntMaxRange)
		{
			Radial = 1.f;
		}
		const FVector Side(-ToTarget.Y, ToTarget.X, 0.f);
		const FVector Wish = (ToTarget * Radial + Side * (0.7f * StrafeSign)).GetSafeNormal();
		FVector Next = Here + Wish * (Tuning.GruntMoveSpeed * DeltaSeconds);
		if (bHasHome)
		{
			const FVector2D Clamped = ClampToHome(Next);
			if (!FMath::IsNearlyEqual(Clamped.X, Next.X) || !FMath::IsNearlyEqual(Clamped.Y, Next.Y))
			{
				// At the edge of its area: turn the sidestep around.
				StrafeSign = -StrafeSign;
				StrafeClock = 0.f;
			}
			Next.X = Clamped.X;
			Next.Y = Clamped.Y;
		}
		FHitResult Hit;
		SetActorLocation(Next, true, &Hit);
		if (Hit.bBlockingHit)
		{
			StrafeSign = -StrafeSign;
			StrafeClock = 0.f;
		}
	}

	// Fire on a steady clock. The clock waits at the start of the windup while the player is out of sight.
	const float WindupStart = Tuning.GruntFireInterval - Tuning.GruntWindup;

	FireClock += DeltaSeconds;
	if (!bSees)
	{

	if (ClockBefore <= WindupStart && FireClock > WindupStart)

## Five-minute start (from c4, Git Bash)

The commands below use `[pc-b]`; `[pc-c]` and `pc2` take the same commands (on pc2 add `-TimeoutSeconds 900` to `run`).
Pick a name for your lane (letters, digits, no spaces): use your lane name, for example `vfx1`. Never use another
lane's name and never `proof` (the farm's own check).

```bash
F="[notes]/unreal/megajam-2026/farm/farm.sh"
LOGS=/d/UE/wt/vfx1_farmlogs          # any folder on c4 outside the worktree; each step writes LOGS/<step>/

"$F" status [pc-b]                                   # 1. load check, see "Before a heavy step" below
"$F" mirror [pc-b] vfx1 /d/UE/wt/vfx1                 # 2. copy your worktree (changed files only)
"$F" build  [pc-b] vfx1 "$LOGS" -Jobs 8               # 3. SupercutEditor, Development
"$F" test   [pc-b] vfx1 "$LOGS"                       # 4. all Supercut tests (or: -Filter Supercut.Rooms)
"$F" package [pc-b] vfx1 "$LOGS"                      # 5. Development package (compiles the game target itself)
"$F" run    [pc-b] vfx1 "$LOGS" -Packaged -Exe '{B}\Supercut59\Windows\Supercut.exe' \
            -Run main8 -Seed 1 -Script '{P}\Script\main8.txt' -FixedFps 240 -Silent      # 6. scripted run
grep "RUN wrapped" "$LOGS/run/run.log"                # 7. compare with the reference line
```

- Every step exits with the remote step's exit code and copies its logs to `$LOGS/<step>/` (old copy replaced).
  `build/ubt_SupercutEditor.log`, `test/tests.log`, `package/package_run.log`, `run/run.log` and `run/shots/*.png`.
  `console.txt` in each is what the Tools script printed, `farm_step.txt` the exit code and seconds.
- Extra words after the log folder go to the project's own script: `build` takes `build.ps1` arguments
  (`-Target Supercut`, `-Jobs 8`), `test` takes `run_tests.ps1` arguments (`-Filter ...`), `run` takes
  `run_demo.ps1` arguments. In them `{P}` is your mirror folder on the PC, `{B}` your packages folder, `{O}` the
  step's log folder. The run step adds `-Log` and `-Shots` (into its log folder) unless you give them.
- `package-shipping` builds the Shipping package to `{B}\Supercut59_ship\Windows`.
- Fetch anything else: `"$F" fetch [pc-b] vfx1 <path> <local folder>`. `<path>` is inside your mirror
  (`Saved/Logs/Supercut.log`), or `builds/...` (packages: `builds/Supercut59/Windows`), or `out/...` (step logs).

{
	const UAnimSequence* Anim = Clip(ClipId);
	const FReferenceSkeleton& Bones = Anim->GetSkeleton()->GetReferenceSkeleton();

		InMesh = InMesh * Local;
	}

#!/bin/bash
# farm.sh: build, test, package and run a SUPERCUT project copy on a farm PC, driven from c4. Details: ../FARM.md.
#
#   farm.sh mirror  <host> <name> <project folder on c4>     copy the project to <root>\Farm\<name> (changed files only)
#   farm.sh build   <host> <name> <log folder> [build.ps1 args, e.g. -Target Supercut -Jobs 8]
#   farm.sh test    <host> <name> <log folder> [run_tests.ps1 args, e.g. -Filter Supercut.Rooms]
#   farm.sh package <host> <name> <log folder>               Tools\package.cmd   -> <root>\Farm\_builds\<name>\Supercut59
#   farm.sh package-shipping <host> <name> <log folder>      Tools\package_shipping.cmd -> ...\_builds\<name>\Supercut59_ship
#   farm.sh run     <host> <name> <log folder> [run_demo.ps1 args]   {P} = the mirror folder there, e.g. -Script {P}\Script\main8.txt
#   farm.sh fetch   <host> <name> <remote path> <local folder>   path in the mirror, or builds/... or out/...
#   farm.sh status  <host>
#   farm.sh slots                                             who holds or waits for which PC right now
#
# Each step brings its logs back to <log folder>/<step>/ and exits with the remote step's exit code.
# Logs that come back have the PC's user and computer names replaced by USER and PC.
#
# Hosts: [pc-b], pc2, [pc-c], pc4 over ssh, and c4 itself (15 Nov: the owner freed c4 for lanes). On c4 nothing is
# copied: "mirror" makes D:\UE\Farm\<name> a junction to the project folder, so the steps build in that folder.
#
# Slots (15 Nov): build, test, package, package-shipping and run take one of the host's slots and wait for one
# when all are taken, so the lanes no longer pile onto one PC. A slot whose farm.sh has died is taken over.

def burst(t0, t1, tag, step=0.1, out=None):
    # aim, report and a picture every step: the report line names the clip each picture shows
    t = t0
    while t < t1 - 1e-6:
        out.append("%.2f aim 0" % t)
        out.append("%.2f report" % (t + 0.01))
        out.append("%.2f shot %s_%03d" % (t + 0.02, tag, int(round(t * 100))))
        t += step
def write(name, head, body):
    open(name, "w", newline="\r\n").write("\n".join(head + body) + "\n")

# Grunt: 14 m strafing (aim, fire), a freeze at 14 m then 5 m, 5 m backing off, hits, the kill, the body; then 20 m forward.

## SUPERCUT slice lane (13 Nov 2026, c4, engine 5.9 preview)

- **The material editing library will not compile under `-nullrhi`** (13 Nov 2026, verified). A Python commandlet run
  with `-nullrhi` fails with "Cannot compile material ... no renderer", after `fresh()` has already deleted the old
  asset. Run make_assets with `-AllowCommandletRendering` instead; it stays headless. `recompile_material` only queues
  the compile there: the shaders really compile in the package cook, so read `package_run.log` for material errors.
- **A post-process material after tonemapping reads jittered depth and normals** (13 Nov 2026, verified). TSR has
  smoothed the colour by then, but SceneDepth, WorldNormal and the stencil are this frame's jittered samples, so
  outlines drawn from them crawl by a pixel on a still camera (3.6% of wall pixels changed between two still frames).
  TSR forces 8 jitter samples whatever `r.TemporalAASamples` says (SceneVisibility.cpp, the TSR branch). The fix that
  worked: a `FWorldSceneViewExtension` whose `SetupView` sets `View.bAllowTemporalJitter = false` while the effect is

## SUPERCUT vfx1 lane: Niagara effects built by script (14 Nov 2026, verified by the lane)

Full list and the ten-minute recipe for a new effect: `megajam-2026/lanes/vfx1/HANDOFF.md`, sections 1 and 10.

- Niagara systems can be authored with no open editor: `UnrealEditor-Cmd ... -run=pythonscript -Script=Tools\make_vfx.py
  -EnablePlugins=NiagaraToolsets -AllowCommandletRendering`. The only door from Python is
  `unreal.ToolsetRegistry.execute_tool("NiagaraToolsets.NiagaraToolset_System", tool, json)`. The toolset's own
  functions are `AICallable`, not `BlueprintCallable`, so Python has no binding for them.
- In a system built this way, the LAST emitter does not draw sprites whose size or life is an expression on a user
  number (`User.Size * 4.0`). Found by bisecting, cause in the engine not found. Cure: end every system with an
  empty emitter (`End`). `System.save()` in the script adds it.
- The toolset's `GetSystemCompileState` and `GetStackIssues` never return in a commandlet. Read the log for
  `LogNiagaraCompiler: Error` and `LogMaterial: Error` instead.
- Particle colours are linear light: 0.21 shows as middle grey. The particle script machine has no `smoothstep`.
- Inputs behind a mode switch ("Lifetime Mode", "Sprite Size Mode") do not exist until the mode is set.

void ASupercutMarksman::DrawLine(const FVector& From, const FVector& Direction)
{
	const FSupercutTuning& Tuning = FSupercutTuning::Get();
	// The line ends where the shot would first meet something: a wall, cover or a body.
	FCollisionObjectQueryParams Objects;
	Objects.AddObjectTypesToQuery(ECC_WorldStatic);
	Objects.AddObjectTypesToQuery(ECC_WorldDynamic);
	Objects.AddObjectTypesToQuery(ECC_Pawn);
	FCollisionQueryParams Params(SCENE_QUERY_STAT(SupercutMarksmanLine), false, this);
	FHitResult Hit;
	const FVector Far = From + Direction * Tuning.MarksmanSightRange;
	LineEnd = GetWorld()->LineTraceSingleByObjectType(Hit, From, Far, Objects, Params) ? Hit.Location : Far;
	// Drawn from the gun's muzzle, which the clip moves, until it locks; the shot's own line (From) is game logic and stays.
	LineStart = bLocked ? LockedLineStart : GetMuzzleLocation();

	// The cylinder is 100 cm along its own Z: put its middle half way and turn Z along the line.
	const float Width = bLocked ? Tuning.MarksmanLockedLineWidth : Tuning.MarksmanLineWidth;
	Line->SetWorldLocationAndRotation((LineStart + LineEnd) * 0.5f, FRotationMatrix::MakeFromZ(LineEnd - LineStart).Rotator());
	Line->SetWorldScale3D(FVector(Width, Width, FVector::Dist(LineStart, LineEnd)) / 100.0);
	Line->SetVisibility(true, true);
}

void ASupercutMarksman::DrawLine(const FVector& From, const FVector& Direction)
{
	const FSupercutTuning& Tuning = FSupercutTuning::Get();
	// The line ends where the shot would first meet something: a wall, cover or a body.
	FCollisionObjectQueryParams Objects;
	Objects.AddObjectTypesToQuery(ECC_WorldStatic);
	Objects.AddObjectTypesToQuery(ECC_WorldDynamic);
	Objects.AddObjectTypesToQuery(ECC_Pawn);
	FCollisionQueryParams Params(SCENE_QUERY_STAT(SupercutMarksmanLine), false, this);
	FHitResult Hit;
	const FVector Far = From + Direction * Tuning.MarksmanSightRange;
	const FVector ShotEnd = GetWorld()->LineTraceSingleByObjectType(Hit, From, Far, Objects, Params) ? Hit.Location : Far;
	// Drawn from the gun's muzzle, which the clip moves; the shot's own line (From) is game logic and stays. Once locked
	// the drawn line keeps its start and direction and only its length follows the shot's end.
	if (bLocked)
	{
		LineStart = LockedLineStart;
		LineEnd = LineStart + LockedLineDirection * FVector::Dist(LineStart, ShotEnd);
	}
	else
	{
		LineStart = GetMuzzleLocation();
		LineEnd = ShotEnd;
	}

	// The cylinder is 100 cm along its own Z: put its middle half way and turn Z along the line.
	const float Width = bLocked ? Tuning.MarksmanLockedLineWidth : Tuning.MarksmanLineWidth;
	Line->SetWorldLocationAndRotation((LineStart + LineEnd) * 0.5f, FRotationMatrix::MakeFromZ(LineEnd - LineStart).Rotator());
	Line->SetWorldScale3D(FVector(Width, Width, FVector::Dist(LineStart, LineEnd)) / 100.0);
	Line->SetVisibility(true, true);
}

**Sun 15 Nov 18:13:53 · Tool call: Bash** (Integrability test of each normal map's green channel)

```
cd /d/UE/wt/enemyanim1/Art/sourced && python -I - <<'EOF'
from PIL import Image
import numpy as np
def curl_score(path, s):
    a = np.asarray(Image.open(path).convert("RGB")).astype(np.float64) / 255.0
    nx = 2 * a[..., 0] - 1
    ny = s * (2 * a[..., 1] - 1)
    nz = np.clip(2 * a[..., 2] - 1, 0.2, 1)
    gx, gy = -nx / nz, -ny / nz          # slopes along columns and rows
    # curl of (gx, gy) over the pixel grid; only where the map has detail
    c = (gy[:, 1:] - gy[:, :-1])[:-1, :] - (gx[1:, :] - gx[:-1, :])[:, :-1]
    detail = (np.abs(nx) + np.abs(ny))[:-1, :-1] > 0.05
    return float(np.abs(c[detail]).mean()), int(detail.sum())
for name, path in (("rifle body (DirectX, control)", "marksman_rifle/T_MarksmanRifle_N.png"),
                   ("scope", "marksman_rifle/T_MarksmanScope_N.png"),
                   ("pistol", "grunt_pistol/T_GruntPistol_N.png")):
    p, n = curl_score(path, +1); m, _ = curl_score(path, -1)
    print("%-30s green as is: %.4f   green flipped: %.4f   (%d detail pixels) -> lower curl with %s" % (name, p, m, n, "as is" if p < m else "flipped"))
EOF

**Sun 15 Nov 18:14:06 · Tool call: Bash** (Seam-robust integrability test)

```
cd /d/UE/wt/enemyanim1/Art/sourced && python -I - <<'EOF'
from PIL import Image
import numpy as np
def score(path, s):
    a = np.asarray(Image.open(path).convert("RGB")).astype(np.float64) / 255.0
    nx = 2 * a[..., 0] - 1; ny = s * (2 * a[..., 1] - 1); nz = np.clip(2 * a[..., 2] - 1, 0.2, 1)
    gx, gy = -nx / nz, -ny / nz
    c = (gy[:, 1:] - gy[:, :-1])[:-1, :] - (gx[1:, :] - gx[:-1, :])[:, :-1]
    jump = np.maximum(np.abs(gx[1:, :-1] - gx[:-1, :-1]) + np.abs(gx[:-1, 1:] - gx[:-1, :-1]),
                      np.abs(gy[1:, :-1] - gy[:-1, :-1]) + np.abs(gy[:-1, 1:] - gy[:-1, :-1]))
    keep = ((np.abs(nx) + np.abs(ny))[:-1, :-1] > 0.08) & (jump < 0.3)
    return float(np.median(np.abs(c[keep]))), float(np.abs(c[keep]).mean()), int(keep.sum())
for name, path in (("rifle body (control)", "marksman_rifle/T_MarksmanRifle_N.png"),
                   ("scope", "marksman_rifle/T_MarksmanScope_N.png"),
                   ("pistol", "grunt_pistol/T_GruntPistol_N.png")):
    a = score(path, +1); b = score(path, -1)
    print("%-22s as is: median %.5f mean %.5f | flipped: median %.5f mean %.5f | n=%d" % (name, a[0], a[1], b[0], b[1], a[2]))
EOF

Output: `Art/figures/fbx/anim/A_LayFigure_<Name>.fbx`.\n- Method: per bone, the world-space rotation change from the source's rest pose, with a rest-direction correction so the\n  bones point the same way as the source's. Mixamo's locomotion drift is removed (clips stay in place, as the game moves\n  the actor) and the pelvis travel is scaled by the leg ratio (0.933).\n- Export: cm, -Z forward, Y up, a rest key at frame 0-1, clip shifted to time 0 (Blender reads FBX time 0 as frame 1).\n- Self-test: a library clip retargeted onto its own skeleton comes back within 0.0002 cm per bone.\n- Stride speed per moving clip: the median 2D speed of the planted toe (within 2.5 cm of its lowest point; 1 cm found\n  no planted frames in the running strafes because their feet roll). {
 "file_path": "[notes]\\unreal\\megajam-2026\\lanes\\enemyanim1\\scripts\\label_shots.py",
 "content": "# Labels each picture of a run by the clip the \"report\" line before it names, the distance to the enemy and whether time\n# was frozen, then writes one sheet per run with the first picture of each (clip, distance band, frozen) and a CSV of all.\n#   python -I label_shots.py <run folder (holds run.log and shots/)> <out folder> <name>\nimport csv\nimport math\nimport os\nimport re\nimport sys\n\nfrom PIL import Image, ImageDraw\n\nrun, out, name = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2], sys.argv[3]\nlog = open(os.path.join(run, \"run.log\"), encoding=\"utf-8\", errors=\"replace\").read().splitlines()\nenemy_at, clip, rows = None, \"?\", []\nfor line in log:\n    m = re.search(r\"SCRIPT ([0-9.]+) (\\w+)(.*)\", line)\n    if not m:\n        continue\n    t, cmd, rest = float(m.group(1)), m.group(2), m.group(3)\n    pos = re.search(r\"pos V\\(([^)]*)\\)\", rest)\n    me = {}\n    if pos:\n        for kv in pos.group(1).split(\",\"):\n            k, v = kv.strip().split(\"=\")\n            me[k] = float(v)\n    if cmd == \"aim\":\n        e = re.search(r\"at V\\(([^)]*)\\)\", rest)\n        if e:\n            enemy_at = {}\n            for kv in e.group(1).split(\",\"):\n                k, v = kv.strip().split(\"=\")\n                enemy_at[k] = float(v)\n    elif cmd == \"report\":\n        c = re.findall(r\"clip (\\w+)\", rest)\n        clip = c[0] if c else \"none\"\n    elif cmd == \"shot\":\n        file = re.search(r\"shot (\\S+)\\|\", line).group(1)\n        dist = None\n        if enemy_at and me:\n            dist = math.hypot(enemy_at.get(\"X\", 0) - me.get(\"X\", 0), enemy_at.get(\"Y\", 0) - me.get(\"Y\", 0)) / 100.0\n        frozen = rest.rstrip().endswith(\"frozen\")\n        rows.append((t, file, clip, dist, frozen))\n\nos.makedirs(out, exist_ok=True)\nwith open(os.path.join(out, name + \"_labels.csv\"), \"w\", newline=\"\") as f:\n    w = csv.writer(f)\n    w.writerow([\"time\", \"picture\", \"clip\", \"distance_m\", \"frozen\"])\n    for r in rows:\n        w.writerow([r[0], r[1], r[2], \"\" if r[3] is None else \"%.1f\" % r[3], r[4]])\n\npicked, seen = [], set()\nfor r in rows:\n    band = \"?\" if r[3] is None else (\"5m\" if r[3] < 9 else (\"15m\" if r[3] < 17 else \"20m\"))\n    key = (r[2], band, r[4])\n    if key not in seen:\n        seen.add(key)\n        picked.append((r, band))\ntw, th = 480, 270\ncols = 2\nsheet = Image.new(\"RGB\", (tw * cols, th * ((len(picked) + cols - 1) // cols)), (20, 20, 20))\nd = ImageDraw.Draw(sheet)\nfor i, (r, band) in enumerate(picked):\n    p = os.path.join(run, \"shots\", r[1] + \".png\")\n    if not os.path.exists(p):\n        continue\n    im = Image.open(p).convert(\"RGB\")\n    im.thumbnail((tw, th))\n    x, y = (i % cols) * tw, (i // cols) * th\n    sheet.paste(im, (x, y))\n    label = \"%s  %s  %s  %.2fs  %s\" % (r[2], band, \"FROZEN\" if r[4] else \"live\", r[0], r[1])\n    d.rectangle([x, y, x + tw, y + 16], fill=(0, 0, 0))\n    d.text((x + 4, y + 2), label, fill=(255, 255, 0))\nsheet.save(os.path.join(out, name + \"_sheet.jpg\"), quality=85)\nprint(name, len(rows), \"pictures,\", len(picked), \"on the sheet:\", \", \".join(\"%s/%s/%s\" % (r[2], b, \"F\" if r[4] else \"L\") for r, b in picked))\n"
}

{
 "file_path": "[notes]\\unreal\\megajam-2026\\lanes\\enemyanim1\\scripts\\crop_sheet.py",
 "content": "# Crops each labelled picture round the enemy (the script's \"aim\" puts its chest in the middle of the frame) at a size set\n# by the distance, so the figure fills its tile, and lays them out with their labels.\n#   python -I crop_sheet.py <run folder> <labels csv> <out jpg> <figure height m> [picture,picture,...]\nimport csv\nimport os\nimport sys\n\nfrom PIL import Image, ImageDraw\n\nrun, labels, out, height = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2], sys.argv[3], float(sys.argv[4])\nwant = sys.argv[5].split(\",\") if len(sys.argv) > 5 else None\nrows = list(csv.DictReader(open(labels)))\nif want:\n    rows = [r for r in rows if r[\"picture\"] in want]\nF = 881.0   # 1920x1080 at a 95 degree horizontal view: focal length in pixels\ntile, cols = 320, 3\nsheet = Image.new(\"RGB\", (tile * cols, (tile + 18) * ((len(rows) + cols - 1) // cols)), (20, 20, 20))\nd = ImageDraw.Draw(sheet)\nfor i, r in enumerate(rows):\n    im = Image.open(os.path.join(run, \"shots\", r[\"picture\"] + \".png\")).convert(\"RGB\")\n    dist = float(r[\"distance_m\"]) if r[\"distance_m\"] else 5.0\n    h = F * height / max(dist, 2.0)\n    side = int(min(1060, 2.4 * h))\n    cx, cy = 960, int(540 + 0.2 * h)\n    box = (cx - side // 2, max(0, cy - side // 2), cx + side // 2, min(1080, cy + side // 2))\n    crop = im.crop(box).resize((tile, tile))\n    x, y = (i % cols) * tile, (i // cols) * (tile + 18)\n    sheet.paste(crop, (x, y + 18))\n    d.text((x + 3, y + 3), \"%s %sm %s %ss\" % (r[\"clip\"], r[\"distance_m\"] or \"?\", \"FROZEN\" if r[\"frozen\"] == \"True\" else \"live\", r[\"time\"]), fill=(255, 255, 0))\nsheet.save(out, quality=88)\nprint(out, len(rows))\n"
}

import csv
# pick: first picture per (clip, band, frozen) and a few extra per kind

    for r in rows:
        d = float(r["distance_m"]) if r["distance_m"] else 0
        band = "5" if d < 9 else ("15" if d < 17 else "20")
        k = (r["clip"], band, r["frozen"])
        seen[k] = seen.get(k, 0) + 1
        if seen[k] <= 2:
            pick.append(r["picture"])
    open("shots/pics/%s_pick.txt" % name, "w").write(",".join(pick))
    print(name, len(pick))
EOF

```
cd "/c/Users/USER/AppData/Local/Temp/claude/ce66ae306241b5fa/bd0475c4-5e86-400a-98a1-4e30cf776611/scratchpad" && cat > div_test.py <<'EOF'
# Red is the same in both normal map conventions; green is flipped between them. For any height field, the red-derived
# and green-derived second derivatives of height correlate positively when green is read in the right convention.
import sys
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
n = np.asarray(Image.open(sys.argv[1]).convert("RGB"), dtype=np.float64) / 127.5 - 1.0
bc = np.asarray(Image.open(sys.argv[2]).convert("L"), dtype=np.float64)
r, g = n[..., 0], n[..., 1]
hxx = -np.gradient(r, axis=1)            # -d(nx)/dcol, convention free
hyy_gl = np.gradient(g, axis=0)          # if green = +Y up (OpenGL), d(g)/drow = h_yy
c = np.corrcoef(hxx.ravel(), hyy_gl.ravel())[0, 1]
print("corr(h_xx from red, h_yy if green is up) = %+.3f  -> %s" % (c, "OpenGL (green up)" if c > 0 else "DirectX (green down)"))
# scratches: bright thin lines in the base colour, compared with their surroundings
from scipy.ndimage import uniform_filter
hi = bc - uniform_filter(bc, 15)
m = hi > np.percentile(hi, 98)
print("scratch pixels", m.sum(), " mean h_xx on them %+.4f (positive = cut, from red alone)" % hxx[m].mean(),
      " mean h_yy if green up %+.4f" % hyy_gl[m].mean())
EOF
python -I div_test.py "D:/UE/wt/enemyanim1/Art/sourced/marksman_rifle/T_MarksmanScope_N.png" "D:/UE/wt/enemyanim1/Art/sourced/marksman_rifle/T_MarksmanScope_BC.png"
```

cd "/c/Users/USER/AppData/Local/Temp/claude/ce66ae306241b5fa/bd0475c4-5e86-400a-98a1-4e30cf776611/scratchpad" && cat > div_test2.py <<'EOF'
import sys
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
from scipy.ndimage import uniform_filter
n = np.asarray(Image.open(sys.argv[1]).convert("RGB"), dtype=np.float64) / 127.5 - 1.0
bc = np.asarray(Image.open(sys.argv[2]).convert("L"), dtype=np.float64)
orm = np.asarray(Image.open(sys.argv[3]).convert("RGB"), dtype=np.float64)
print("normal size", n.shape, " bc", bc.shape, " orm", orm.shape)
r, g = n[..., 0], n[..., 1]
hxx, hyy = -np.gradient(r, axis=1), np.gradient(g, axis=0)
print("std h_xx %.4f  std h_yy %.4f" % (hxx.std(), hyy.std()))
for name, img, sign in (("bright in BC", bc, 1), ("dark in BC", bc, -1), ("dark in AO", orm[..., 0], -1), ("rough diff", orm[..., 1], 1)):
    hi = sign * (img - uniform_filter(img, 15))
    for p in (98, 99.5):
        m = hi > np.percentile(hi, p)
        se = hxx[m].std() / np.sqrt(m.sum())
        print("%-13s top %.1f%%: n=%6d  h_xx %+.4f (se %.4f)  h_yy(green up) %+.4f" % (name, 100 - p, m.sum(), hxx[m].mean(), se, hyy[m].mean()))
# flatness: how much of the map is near (0,0,1)
print("share of pixels with |nxy| < 0.05: %.2f" % (np.hypot(r, g) < 0.05).mean())
EOF

**Sun 15 Nov 18:57:26 · Tool call: Bash** (Run the convention test on all three gun normal maps)

```
cd "/c/Users/USER/AppData/Local/Temp/claude/ce66ae306241b5fa/bd0475c4-5e86-400a-98a1-4e30cf776611/scratchpad" && cat > div_test3.py <<'EOF'
# For each map: on pixels where the normal tilts, does green's h_yy agree in sign with red's h_xx locally (3x3 box)?
import sys
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
from scipy.ndimage import uniform_filter
for path in sys.argv[1:]:
    n = np.asarray(Image.open(path).convert("RGB"), dtype=np.float64) / 127.5 - 1.0
    r, g = n[..., 0], n[..., 1]
    hxx, hyy = uniform_filter(-np.gradient(r, axis=1), 5), uniform_filter(np.gradient(g, axis=0), 5)
    m = (np.abs(hxx) > 2 * hxx.std()) & (np.abs(hyy) > 2 * hyy.std())
    agree = (np.sign(hxx[m]) == np.sign(hyy[m])).mean()
    print("%-28s n=%6d  share where green-as-up agrees with red: %.2f -> %s" % (path.split("/")[-1], m.sum(), agree, "OpenGL" if agree > 0.5 else "DirectX"))
EOF

**Sun 15 Nov 18:58:13 · Tool call: Bash** (Check the convention test on known synthetic maps)

```
cd "/c/Users/USER/AppData/Local/Temp/claude/ce66ae306241b5fa/bd0475c4-5e86-400a-98a1-4e30cf776611/scratchpad" && python -I - <<'EOF'
# Known answer: a height field of random bumps and dents, written as an OpenGL map (green = +V, up in the picture)
# and a DirectX map, then the same test as div_test3.
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
from scipy.ndimage import gaussian_filter
rng = np.random.default_rng(1)
h = gaussian_filter(rng.normal(size=(512, 512)), 4) * 40
dh_dcol = np.gradient(h, axis=1)
dh_dup = -np.gradient(h, axis=0)        # rows grow downward
for name, gsign in (("synthetic_GL", 1), ("synthetic_DX", -1)):
    n = np.dstack([-dh_dcol, gsign * -dh_dup, np.ones_like(h)])
    n /= np.linalg.norm(n, axis=2, keepdims=True)
    Image.fromarray(((n * 0.5 + 0.5) * 255).round().astype(np.uint8)).save(name + ".png")
EOF
python -I div_test3.py synthetic_GL.png synthetic_DX.png

landing;\n  a pose that plays out (fire, reload, throw, strike, land); fire; aim; crouched idle or idle.\n- `SupercutFigure::PoseRate`: a moving clip plays at speed / (stride speed x figure scale) x the set's rate (-1 plays it\n  backwards).\n- Each kind returns a `FSupercutClipSet` from `GetClipSet()`. `CheckClipSet` at BeginPlay is Fatal if a pose every enemy\n  reaches has no clip, or a group (moving, crouched, jump) is half filled.\n- `ASupercutEnemy::FillMotionFromState` is the one base-class function that fills the motion from the old state machine.\n  Lane gruntai1 replaces it for the Grunt; nothing else reads the old state for the look.\n- No blending: one clip at a time, hard cuts.\n\nSets per kind:\n\n| Pose | Grunt (pistol) | Marksman (sniper rifle) | Rusher (unarmed) |\n| --- | --- | --- | --- |\n| Idle | Pistol_Idle_Loop | Rifle_Idle | Idle_Loop |\n| Aim | Pistol_Aim_Neutral | Rifle_Aim_Idle | Punch_Cross, rate 0 (windup, frame 0) |\n| Fire | Pistol_Shoot | Rifle_Fire | |\n| Reload | Pistol_Reload | | |\n| Throw | Grenade_Toss | | |\n| Strike | | | Punch_Cross |\n| Hit | Hit_Chest | Rifle_Hit, rate 2.5 | Hit_Chest |\n| Dead | Death01 | Rifle_Death | Death01 |\n| Forward / Back | Pistol_Walk_Fwd / Pistol_Walk_Back | (stands still) | Sprint_Loop / Sprint_Loop backwards |\n| Left / Right | Pistol_Strafe_L / _R | | Run_Strafe_L / _R |\n| Crouched idle / moves | Pistol_Kneel_Aim / Crouch_Fwd_Loop | | |\n| Jump | Jump_Start, Jump_Loop, Jump_Land | | |\n\nStride speeds (cm/s at figure scale 1): Sprint 895, Pistol_Walk_Fwd 248.4, Pistol_Walk_Back 139.8, Pistol_Strafe_L 217.0,\nPistol_Strafe_R 238.6, Crouch_Fwd 72.2, Run_Strafe_L 426.1, Run_Strafe_R 422.9. The tuning lines GruntMoveClipRate and\nRusherRunClipRate are gone: the rate now comes from the speed.\n\n## Guns, hand fit, shot start, aim line\n\n- `EnemyGunPartTable` is now one gun per kind: Grunt `SM_GruntPistol`, Marksman `SM_MarksmanRifle` (body and scope\n  slots), Rusher none. Each sits in the right hand by its grip point (`SupercutFigure::PistolOnHand` and the rifle's\n  grip transform), unscaled. A missing mesh or material is Fatal (`FigureLoadOrDie`).\n- Sources: `Art/sourced/grunt_pistol/`, `Art/sourced/marksman_rifle/`, each with SOURCE.txt from lane guns1. Material\n  `M_EnemyGun` (base colour, ORM, normal) with one instance per slot.\n- Shot start stays game logic. Gaps printed by `ShotsStartAtTheDrawnMuzzle`: the Grunt's drawn pistol muzzle is 8.4 cm\n  from the logic's shot start; the Marksman's drawn rifle muzzle is 38.4 cm from it (a long rifle, so the logic's start\n  was kept, as the brief said). main8 and gen print the same lines as the base, so who gets hit did not change.\n- Support hand: the Marksman's left palm is 2.2 cm from the rifle's fore-end in Rifle_Aim_Idle (well under a hand's width).\n  The Grunt's pistol clips are one-handed or two-handed on the grip; at 5 m and beyond no hand shows through the gun.\n- Aim line: the Marksman's drawn line and glint start at the rifle muzzle (the old code's intent was the muzzle: the\n  line came from the drawn muzzle point). While it tracks, the start follows the swaying muzzle; at the lock the line\n  freezes as drawn (start and direction) and only its length follows the shot's end. Without that freeze the locked\n  line turned as the aim clip swayed the rifle (`WalkingSidewaysThroughTheLockIsNotHit` caught it; test unchanged).\n\n## Checks and numbers\n\nAll on [pc-c] unless said. Re-run with the lane scripts: `scripts/base_runs.sh` (base `aeff075` + `fa6cab8`),\n`scripts/after_runs.sh` (branch head), `scripts/picture_runs.sh`, `scripts/flip_ab.sh`.\n\n- Build: passes on [pc-c] (93 s) and c4.\n- Tests (c4, full run): 254 passed, 0 failed.\n- Development package: 305 s; cook log 0 `Failed to compile Material`, 0 `missing usage flag`, no warning on my assets.\n  FLIP_PACKAGE\n- main8 twice: `takes 1, time 98.2 s, shots 46, freezes 14, kills 17` both times. The pistol is hidden (item 1).\n- Marksman: idle, aim, fire, hit, death (the rifle lies by the body), frozen: all read right.\n- Rusher: Sprint reads right; the strafe flashes (item 4); hit and death only at 24 m (item 6).\n- The crosshair sits on the chest in every picture, as the script aims it there.\n\n## Tests: new, and every changed expectation with its reason\n\nCompared with `fa6cab8`. None deleted or loosened in what they guard.\n\nNew:\n- `Supercut.Figures.PickerReadsOnlyTheMotion`: the picker's choice changes only with the motion (seam check).\n- `Supercut.Figures.EachKindPicksItsClips`: each kind, travel forward, backward, left and right against its facing,\n  gets its own clip; plus its idle, aim, fire, hit, dead.\n- `Supercut.Figures.EachKindHoldsItsOwnGun` (replaces `EnemiesHoldTheRevolver`): Grunt the pistol, Marksman the rifle\n  with both slots, Rusher nothing.\n- `AssetsAreAsImported` now also loads every clip the game asks for by name, through the game's own path.\n\nChanged expectations:\n- Grunt windup and just-fired: expected PistolAim and PistolShoot, now a strafe clip. # Exact-text replacements in a CRLF source file, kept CRLF.
#   python -I crlf_edit.py <file> <edits.txt>
# edits.txt holds blocks: a line "<<<<", the old text, a line "====", the new text, a line ">>>>". Each old text must
# occur exactly once.
import sys

path, edits_path = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
text = open(path, "rb").read().decode("utf-8")
crlf = "\r\n" in text
text = text.replace("\r\n", "\n")
spec = open(edits_path, "rb").read().decode("utf-8").replace("\r\n", "\n")
blocks = spec.split("<<<<\n")[1:]
for block in blocks:
    old, rest = block.split("\n====\n", 1)
    new = rest.rsplit("\n>>>>", 1)[0]
```

#   farm.sh fetch   <host> <name> <remote path> <local folder>   path in the mirror, or builds/... or out/...
#   farm.sh status  <host>
#   farm.sh slots                                             who holds or waits for which PC right now
#
# Each step brings its logs back to <log folder>/<step>/ and exits with the remote step's exit code.
# Logs that come back have the PC's user and computer names replaced by USER and PC.
#
# Hosts: [pc-b], pc2, [pc-c], pc4 over ssh, and c4 itself (15 Nov: the owner freed c4 for lanes). On c4 nothing is
# copied: "mirror" makes D:\UE\Farm\<name> a junction to the project folder, so the steps build in that folder.
#
# Slots (15 Nov): build, test, package, package-shipping and run take one of the host's slots and wait for one
# when all are taken, so the lanes no longer pile onto one PC. A slot whose farm.sh has died is taken over.
# UnrealBuildTool runs one at a time per engine copy, and a package that meets another lane's build fails
# (exit 10, 15 Nov 14:04 on [pc-c]). So build, package and package-shipping also hold <lockdir>/<host>.ubt.
```

Author: Supercut build <[email]>
Date:   Sun Nov 15 18:14:56 2026 +0800

    SUPERCUT enemyanim1: enemies show their clips from the motion, and hold their own guns (Part C)
    
    The clip picker (SupercutFigure::PickPose) reads only ASupercutEnemy::GetMotion():
    dead, hit, in the air, acts, then moving (forward, backward, left or right from
    the velocity against the facing), fire, aim, idle. A moving clip's play rate is
    the actor's speed over the clip's stride speed. FillMotionFromState is the one
    base-class function that fills the motion from the old state machine (lane
    gruntai1 replaces it for the Grunt). Each kind has a clip set; a kind with no
    clip for a pose it reaches is Fatal at BeginPlay. Behaviour is unchanged.
    
    Grunt: library pistol clips plus Mixamo pistol walk, back walk and strafes, the
    kneeling aim and the grenade toss; it holds SM_GruntPistol. Marksman: rifle idle,
    aim, fire, hit and death; it holds SM_MarksmanRifle (fitted to the right hand and
    the left palm in the aim pose). Rusher: sprint and running strafes, unarmed.
    Shots still start where the old drawn muzzle was (GetShotStart, logic); the
    Marksman's aim line is drawn from its rifle's muzzle and holds still once locked.
    The script command report also prints each enemy's clip. Picture and frame-time
    rooms and scripts: Content/Rooms/demo/enemyanim1_*, Script/enemyanim1_*.
    
    Gun models: lane guns1 (CC0), sources in Art/sourced/<gun>/SOURCE*.txt.

#pragma once

#include "CoreMinimal.h"
#include "GameFramework/Actor.h"
#include "SupercutEnemyMotion.h"
#include "SupercutFigure.h"
#include "SupercutShapes.h"
#include "SupercutEnemy.generated.h"

class FSupercutPieceReader;
class UCapsuleComponent;
class USkeletalMeshComponent;
class UStaticMeshComponent;
class UMaterialInstanceDynamic;

/**
 * What every enemy kind shares: health, taking a hit and its flash, dying, the one it fights, the
 * floor area it may move in, its number in the room, and stopping in a freeze.
 *
 * A kind (Grunt, Rusher, Marksman) is a wooden lay figure (AddFigure) that plays one clip at a time, builds it
 * in BuildBody and fights in TickCombat. Shots only ever meet the capsule. The clip is picked from Motion alone
 * (SupercutFigure::PickPose) out of the kind's table (GetClipSet), after every combat frame.
 * Shots, upgrades, the run and the scripted player only ever see this class.
 *
 * A hit plays the kind's hit clip, then the kind's own clip again. A killed enemy plays its death clip and lies
 * where it fell, holding the last frame, until the room goes. From the kill on, nothing of it collides.
 *
 * A hit while rolling also holds this enemy's own clock (USupercutTime::Hold, HitHoldSeconds, or
 * KillHoldSeconds on a kill, when Death01 waits for the hold to end) and shakes the drawn figure, never the
 * capsule or the actor (HitShakeCm). In a freeze neither happens.
 *
 * Everything runs on the actor's own tick time. The base joins the frozen scene, so a freeze gives
 * every kind a tick of zero seconds and the base returns before any kind code runs: mid-windup,
 * mid-lunge and mid-aim all stop where they are, and no timer counts. Its clip stops with it: the figure
 * ticks with the actor's time dilation.
 */
UCLASS(Abstract)
class ASupercutEnemy : public AActor
{
	GENERATED_BODY()

public:
	ASupercutEnemy();

	virtual void BeginPlay() override;
	virtual void Tick(float DeltaSeconds) override;

	void TakeHit(int32 Damage, const FVector& ShotDirection);

	int32 GetHealth() const { return Health; }
	bool IsDying() const { return bDying; }
	/** Enemies are numbered 0, 1, 2 in the order of their lines in the room file, whatever their kind. */
	int32 GetIndex() const { return Index; }
	FBox2D GetHome() const { return Home; }
	FVector GetChestLocation() const { return GetActorLocation() + FVector(0.f, 0.f, ChestHeight); }

	/** What its body is doing this frame (SupercutEnemyMotion.h). */
	const FSupercutEnemyMotion& GetMotion

void ASupercutEnemy::StartClip(ESupercutClip Clip)
{
	Shown = Clip;
	Figure->PlayAnimation(SupercutFigure::Clip(Clip), SupercutFigure::IsLoop(Clip));
	Figure->SetPosition(0.f, false);
	Figure->SetPlayRate(1.f);
}

void ASupercutEnemy::UpdateLook(bool bRestart)
{
	const ESupercutPose Pose = SupercutFigure::PickPose(Motion, GetActorForwardVector(), ShownPose, Figure->IsPlaying());
	const FSupercutClipChoice& Choice = GetClipSet()[Pose];
	if (Choice.Clip == ESupercutClip::None)
	{
		UE_LOG(LogSupercut, Fatal, TEXT("%s %d reached the pose %s and has no clip for it (its GetClipSet)."), GetKindName(), Index, SupercutFigure::PoseName(Pose));
	}
	ShownPose = Pose;
	if (bRestart || Choice.Clip != Shown)
	{
		StartClip(Choice.Clip);
	}
	Figure->SetPlayRate(SupercutFigure::PoseRate(Choice, Pose, Motion, Figure->GetRelativeScale3D().X));
}

void ASupercutGrunt::BuildBody()
{
	// Its own random: the same room and place give the same Grunt every run.
	const FVector Start = GetActorLocation();
	Random.Initialize(GetIndex() * 7919 + int32(FMath::RoundToInt(Start.X)) * 31 + int32(FMath::RoundToInt(Start.Y)));
	AddFigure(TEXT("Grunt"), GruntFigureScale);
	USceneComponent* Gun = SupercutEnemyGun::Add(this, GetFigure());
	MuzzleMaterial = SupercutShapes::Glow(this, SupercutShapes::SignalColor(SupercutShapes::ESignal::Danger), 1.f);
	// On the drawn muzzle. Its size is in world cm whatever the figure's scale.
	Muzzle = SupercutShapes::Add(this, Gun, ESupercutShape::Sphere, SupercutFigure::MuzzleOffset(false), FRotator::ZeroRotator, FVector(8.f), MuzzleMaterial);
	Muzzle->SetUsingAbsoluteScale(true);
	MuzzleHalo = SupercutShapes::AddHalo(this, Muzzle, ESupercutShape::Sphere, FVector::OneVector, SupercutShapes::SignalColor(SupercutShapes::ESignal::Danger));
	MuzzleHalo->SetScalarParameterValue(TEXT("Opacity"), 0.f);   // it comes in with the warning
}

FVector ASupercutGrunt::GetMuzzleLocation() const
{
	return Muzzle->GetComponentLocation();
}

void ASupercutGrunt::OnDying()
{
	Muzzle->SetVisibility(false, true);
}

}

ESupercutPose SupercutFigure::PickPose(const FSupercutEnemyMotion& Motion, const FVector& Facing, ESupercutPose Before, bool bBeforePlaying)
{
	using EPose = ESupercutPose;
	using EAct = ESupercutEnemyAct;
	if (Motion.Act == EAct::Dead)
	{
		return EPose::Dead;
	}
	if (Motion.Act == EAct::Hit || (Before == EPose::Hit && bBeforePlaying))
	{
		return EPose::Hit;
	}
	const bool bWasInAir = Before == EPose::JumpStart || Before == EPose::JumpLoop;
	if (Motion.bInAir)
	{
		return Before == EPose::JumpLoop || (Before == EPose::JumpStart && !bBeforePlaying) ? EPose::JumpLoop : EPose::JumpStart;
	}
	switch (Motion.Act)
	{
	case EAct::Strike: return EPose::Strike;
	case EAct::Throw:  return EPose::Throw;
	case EAct::Reload: return EPose::Reload;
	default: break;
	}
	const FVector Flat(Motion.Velocity.X, Motion.Velocity.Y, 0.f);
	if (Flat.Size() >= MovingSpeed)
	{
		const FVector Ahead = FVector(Facing.X, Facing.Y, 0.f).GetSafeNormal();
		const FVector Right(-Ahead.Y, Ahead.X, 0.f);   // X forward, Y right, Z up
		const float Along = FVector::DotProduct(Flat, Ahead);
		const float Across = FVector::DotProduct(Flat, Right);
		if (FMath::Abs(Along) >= FMath::Abs(Across))
		{
			return Along > 0.f ? (Motion.bCrouched ? EPose::CrouchForward : EPose::Forward) : (Motion.bCrouched ? EPose::CrouchBackward : EPose::Backward);
		}
		return Across > 0.f ? (Motion.bCrouched ? EPose::CrouchRight : EPose::Right) : (Motion.bCrouched ? EPose::CrouchLeft : EPose::Left);
	}
	if (bWasInAir)
	{
		return EPose::JumpLand;
	}
	const bool bPlaysOut = Before == EPose::Fire || Before == EPose::Strike || Before == EPose::Throw || Before == EPose::Reload || Before == EPose::JumpLand;
	if (bPlaysOut && bBeforePlaying)
	{
		return Before;
	}
	if (Motion.Act == EAct::Fire)
	{
		return EPose::Fire;
	}
	if (Motion.Act == EAct::Aim)
	{
		return EPose::Aim;
	}
	return Motion.bCrouched ? EPose::CrouchIdle : EPose::Idle;
}

bool SupercutFigure::IsMovingPose(ESupercutPose Pose)
{
	return (Pose >= ESupercutPose::Forward && Pose <= ESupercutPose::Right) || (Pose >= ESupercutPose::CrouchForward && Pose <= ESupercutPose::CrouchRight);
}

FVector SupercutFigure::AimMuzzle(bool bLong)
{
	const FTransform Hand = BoneInClip(ESupercutClip::PistolAim, HandBone, 0.f);
	return Hand.TransformPosition(PistolOnHand().TransformPosition(MuzzleOffset(bLong)));
}

```
void ASupercutShot::UpdateLook()
{
	if (!Core)
	{
		return;
	}
	if (bSpent)
	{
		return;
	}

	// A frozen or hanging shot pulses in real time so it reads as held, not gone.
	const bool bHeld = bHanging || CustomTimeDilation <= 0.f;
	float CoreScale = 1.f;
	float TailScale = 1.f;
	if (bHeld)
	{
		const float Pulse = FMath::Sin(GetWorld()->GetRealTimeSeconds() * 9.f);
		CoreScale = 1.15f + 0.15f * Pulse;
		// A round hanging at the muzzle pulls its tail in, so six of them read as six.
		// A shot stopped in mid-flight keeps its tail: it should look caught in motion.
		TailScale = bHanging ? 0.3f : 1.f;
	}
	Core->SetRelativeScale3D(CoreSize * CoreScale / 100.0);
	if (bDrawnFromGun)
	{
		return;   // its streak is set where the drawing is placed (PlaceDrawing)
	}
	float Length = TailLength * TailScale;
	if (CoreBack > 0.f)
	{
		Length = FMath::Min(Length, Travelled - StreakStart);   // a bullet's streak never reaches back past where it was fired or turned
	}
	Tail->SetRelativeLocation(FVector(-CoreBack - Length * 0.5f, 0.f, 0.f));
	Tail->SetRelativeScale3D(FVector(TailWidth, TailWidth, Length) / 100.0);
}

    "box role=wall  from=-50,-1050,0 to=4050,-1000,400",
    "box role=wall  from=-50,1000,0 to=4050,1050,400",
    "box role=wall  from=-50,-1000,0 to=0,1000,400",
    "box role=wall  from=4000,-1000,0 to=4050,1000,400",
    "box role=crate from=2200,-560,0 to=2360,-400,100",
    "box role=crate from=2200,400,0 to=2360,560,100",
    "box role=flat  from=2700,-150,0 to=2760,250,220",
    "grunt at=3100,-450,0 facing=180 home_from=3000,-550 home_to=3200,-350",
])

     "0.05 expectdeath", "0.10 fly 1100 0 170"]
t, side = 1.0, 1
while t < 14.0:
    if abs((t * 10) % 15) < 1e-6:
        s.append("%.2f move 0 %d" % (t - 0.05, side)); side = -side
    s += ["%.2f aim 0" % t, "%.2f report" % (t + 0.01), "%.2f shot g_%04d" % (t + 0.02, round(t * 100))]
    t = round(t + 0.1, 2)
s.append("14.10 end")
w("Script/enemyanim2_grunt.txt", s)
# Marksman from the side at 5 m: the player stands 5 m in front, steps 3.5 m aside once the line has locked, and the
# shot flies down the locked line past it. Pictures every 0.02 s framed on the Marksman.
s = ["# ENEMYANIM2 pictures of the Marksman's shot from the side at 5 m (muzzle, flash, tracer start), room demo/enemyanim1_marksman.",
     "0.05 expectdeath", "0.10 fly 2000 0 170", "0.20 aim 0"]
t = 1.0
moved = False
while t < 4.6:
    if not moved and t >= 1.36:
        s.append("1.35 fly 2000 350 170"); moved = True
    s += ["%.2f aim 0" % t, "%.3f report" % (t + 0.005), "%.3f shot m_%04d" % (t + 0.01, round(t * 100))]
    t = round(t + 0.02, 2)
s.append("4.70 end")
w("Script/enemyanim2_marksman.txt", s)
print(open(G + "Script/enemyanim2_grunt.txt").read()[:400])
EOF

 "content": "# One picture strip: chosen pictures of a run, each cropped to the same box of the 1920x1080 frame and labelled with\n# the time and the clip the \"report\" line before it names, side by side in rows, at most 960 px wide.\n#   python -I strip.py <run folder (run.log, shots/)> <out.jpg> <x0,y0,x1,y1> <cols> <picture> [<picture> ...]\nimport os\nimport re\nimport sys\n\nfrom PIL import Image, ImageDraw\n\nrun, out, box, cols = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2], tuple(int(v) for v in sys.argv[3].split(\",\")), int(sys.argv[4])\nnames = sys.argv[5:]\nclip, label = \"?\", {}\nfor line in open(os.path.join(run, \"run.log\"), encoding=\"utf-8\", errors=\"replace\"):\n    m = re.search(r\"SCRIPT ([0-9.]+) (\\w+)(.*)\", line)\n    if not m:\n        continue\n    if m.group(2) == \"report\":\n        c = re.findall(r\"clip (\\w+)\", m.group(3))\n        clip = c[0] if c else \"none\"\n    elif m.group(2) == \"shot\":\n        file = re.search(r\"shot (\\S+)\\|\", line).group(1)\n        label[file] = \"%s s  %s\" % (m.group(1), clip)\ntw = 960 // cols\nth = round(tw * (box[3] - box[1]) / (box[2] - box[0]))\nrows = (len(names) + cols - 1) // cols\nsheet = Image.new(\"RGB\", (tw * cols, th * rows), (20, 20, 20))\nd = ImageDraw.Draw(sheet)\nfor i, n in enumerate(names):\n    im = Image.open(os.path.join(run, \"shots\", n + \".png\")).convert(\"RGB\").crop(box).resize((tw, th), Image.LANCZOS)\n    x, y = (i % cols) * tw, (i // cols) * th\n    sheet.paste(im, (x, y))\n    d.rectangle([x, y, x + tw, y + 14], fill=(0, 0, 0))\n    d.text((x + 3, y + 1), label.get(n, n), fill=(255, 255, 0))\nsheet.save(out, quality=88)\nprint(\"STRIP\", out, sheet.size, len(names))\n"
}

void ASupercutShot::Launch(AActor* InShooter, bool bInFromPlayer, const FVector& InVelocity, float InPlayerDamage)
{
	const FSupercutTuning& Tuning = FSupercutTuning::Get();
	Shooter = InShooter;
	bFromPlayer = bInFromPlayer;
	Velocity = InVelocity;
	PlayerDamage = InPlayerDamage;
	PlayerHitCause = Cast<ASupercutMarksman>(InShooter) ? TEXT("marksman shot") : TEXT("shot");
	FireNumber = ++ShotsLaunched;
	Origin = GetActorLocation();
	SetActorRotation(Velocity.Rotation());

	Radius = bFromPlayer ? Tuning.ShotRadius : Tuning.EnemyShotRadius;
	BuildParts();
	if (!bFromPlayer)
	{
		Hum = USupercutAudio::Get(this).PlayOn(TEXT("enemy_shot_fly"), RootComponent);
		if (Hum && Cast<ASupercutMarksman>(InShooter))
		{
			Hum->SetPitchMultiplier(MarksmanHumPitch);   // the table asks for a faster hum on the Marksman's fast shot
		}
	}

	USupercutTime& Time = USupercutTime::Get(this);
	if (bFromPlayer && Time.IsFrozen())
	{
		// Not part of the frozen scene yet: it flies its first metre in real time.
		bHangPending = true;
	}
	else
	{
		Time.JoinScene(this);
	}
}

	const bool bSmall = Radius <= Tuning.ShotRadius;

		// The nose and the halos are children of the core and the tail, and a destroyed parent leaves its children behind.

			Part->GetChildrenComponents(true, Attached);

			}

# An enemy's shot is drawn out of its gun: the streak may reach back to the gun's drawn muzzle, behind where the flight
# (game logic) starts. The flight, its start and its hits do not move.
import sys
ROOT = "D:/UE/wt/enemyanim1/Source/Supercut/"
def edit(name, pairs):
    path = ROOT + name
    text = open(path, "rb").read().decode("utf-8").replace("\r\n", "\n")
    for old, new in pairs:
        n = text.count(old)
        if n != 1:
            sys.exit("%s: %d matches for %r" % (name, n, old[:80]))
        text = text.replace(old, new)
    open(path, "wb").write(text.replace("\n", "\r\n").encode("utf-8"))
    print("OK", name, len(pairs))
